title: Score of a String
summary: Calculate the score of a string by summing the absolute differences between the ASCII values of consecutive characters.
statement: Calculate the score of a string by summing the absolute differences between the ASCII values of consecutive characters.
constraints: For every adjacent character pair, take the absolute difference of their Unicode code points.
Add those differences across the string.
reference_solution:
def adjacent_character_score(s):
    return sum(abs(ord(a)-ord(b)) for a,b in zip(s,s[1:]))
hints: Adjacent pairs are obtained by zipping the string with its one-position suffix.
Convert each character to its code point.
Add the absolute difference for every pair.
The zip enumerates each adjacent boundary once, exactly matching the score definition.
